adaptation_scope: Source/producer/cost provenance and interpretation only; original scientific metrics, analyses and thresholds unchanged.

available_existing_fields.actual_work: transaction.work_before/work_after counts+CPU+wall, per-path metadata.work_before/work_after, C COMPLETE.work and endpoint scoring_work; work ledger never rolled back
available_existing_fields.bank_immediate_successor: C branch row branches[action].trace[0].after, with before/candidate/accepted, parent_state_sha256 and context_sha256. All four original actions retained.
available_existing_fields.guard_and_fallback: trace[].choice (actual field choose, predicted margin, tau, fallback_reason) and transaction accepted/guard_delta/guard_values/guard_output_sha256/clock_advances
available_existing_fields.rollout_first_whole_state_divergence: stage_C/COMPLETE.json paths[].first_legal_divergence_decision and first_legal_divergence_clock; producer compares six decision_state_sha256 entries against paired same-architecture baseline. Aggregate merges COMPLETE path metadata with saved trace.
available_existing_fields.terminal_parameter_identity: endpoint metadata.parameter_sha256 only (plus terminal whole-state hash and actual tensor checkpoint)

can_answer_without_new_science: Whether stored whole postguard successor identities differ under matched context/clock, first whole-state rollout divergence at macro16, guard/fallback activity, actual work and terminal semantics. Equal whole-state hashes support equality of covered components; differing whole-state hashes do not identify which component differs.
context_clock_budget_binding: Training-state digest itself excludes clock, remaining budget and fixed Context. Bind transaction start/end/schedule/action with fixed plan (macro16/horizon96/baseline2), seed/context_sha256/own-warmstart metadata and deterministic tape identity.
critical_null_semantics: Aggregate parameter_optimizer_trace_available=false and first_parameter_optimizer_divergence_clock=null for C mean unavailable by this diagnostic. Do not convert that null to no divergence. C first_complete_legal_hash_divergence_clock comes from producer metadata and can independently be present or null.
scope_limit: C branch tensors are not all literally archived; original fixed reconstruction audits cover four prescribed cases. No claim that all C bank branches have the A/R 576-terminal literal-replay coverage.
unavailable_in_registered_step_diagnosti: Separate parameter and optimizer/momentum hashes at every C decision
